data.one_liner: A swiper and carousel widget for Flutter with multiple layouts and infinite loop support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable swiper/carousel widget for Flutter supporting multiple layouts like stack, tinder, custom layouts, infinite loops, pagination, control buttons, and autoplay.
use_when: You need a carousel or image slider in your Flutter app.
You require custom card animations or built-in layouts like stack and tinder effects.
avoid_when: You only need a basic page view without third-party pagination or custom layouts.
You are looking for an alternative from the catalog like carousel_slider.
strengths: Supports multiple built-in layouts (DEFAULT, STACK, TINDER, CUSTOM)
Includes pagination and control buttons out of the box
weaknesses: Relies on a third-party package for carousel functionality rather than core widgets
data.setup_notes: Add the package dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it.

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is another popular carousel slider widget available in the catalog.
